name: Head-and-shoulders breakdown
hypothesis: A head at least 0.5 ATR above two shoulders that are within 1 ATR of each other, then a close below the latest swing low, reverses the trend.

entry.short: swings(3).high_prev > swings(3).high + 0.5*atr(14) and swings(3).high_prev > swings(3).high_prev2 + 0.5*atr(14) and abs(swings(3).high - swings(3).high_prev2) < atr(14) and cross_below(close, swings(3).low)
entry.long: swings(3).low_prev < swings(3).low - 0.5*atr(14) and swings(3).low_prev < swings(3).low_prev2 - 0.5*atr(14) and abs(swings(3).low - swings(3).low_prev2) < atr(14) and cross_above(close, swings(3).high)
